Dear guys,

I conducted a MGCFA with three groups (six indicators of one latent variable)

Since the sample size in the groups is pretty small, I would like to simulate the model with generated data.


> model.group<-"f1 =~ x1 + x2 +  x4 +  x7 + x8 + x10"
> fit1<-cfa(model.group,data=Data,group="Condition")
> fit2<-cfa(model.group,data=Data,group="Condition",group.equal=c("loadings"))
> fit3<-cfa(model.group,data=Data,group="Condition",group.equal=c("loadings","intercepts"))
> anova(fit1,fit2)
Chi Square Difference Test

messages.subject: Re: MGCFA - simulation of data HELP HELP HELP
parts: I would like to simulate the model with generated data.

You can do this using the simulateData() function in lavaan.  You specify model syntax for the population by fixing parameters.  For example:
 
model.pop <- "f1 =~ c(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)*x1 + c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)*x2 # and so on"

Maybe see this help page if you haven't specified parameters across groups in the model syntax before.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/groups.html

Terry
